name: India Book

strategies.name: in-late
why: its holdout CAGR doesn't beat its benchmark's

strategies.name: in-loud
why: adding it doesn't improve the Book

caveats: Each strategy is tested at its full share (Real-full), the Book it would make once promoted, in the order it joined: the caps' room goes to the strategies chosen first
Forward selection adds the best strategy each round and never removes one: a pair that improves the Book only together, or a strategy that a later one makes unneeded, isn't found
Improving is measured over the range alone; the holdout tests each strategy, and checks the chosen Book's objective, but chooses nothing

The deflated Sharpe counts the variants the research recorded (config/trials.yaml, its census in docs/review/candidate-test-20261028/), over 2016-08-16 to 2026-08-14, against the strategy's own run over the range (its own run a trial too, unless its version is among them); sweeps run on the dashboard aren't counted
Each strategy's holdout is against its own benchmark, on the basis its run had (`holdout.benchmark`): the Book's may differ
A strategy chosen early stays chosen: the chosen Book without it (its `book`) may then not be worse
The benchmark, ^CRSLDX, is compared as its price index: the lake hasn't its total-return levels over the range, so its dividends are left out and the Book's lead over it is overstated
Not yet in the Book backtest: the exposure level (the breakers halve all of the Book, not the Market condition's level; agents issue 46)

Disaster stops are tested on daily bars, each in place from its entry's own session: a low at or under one sells the whole holding at it, or at the open when the price opens under it, with the preset's slippage and no more. A stock a stop sold is bought back only when its strategy trades it again or the breakers' buying back buys it
Each strategy keeps its Stage over the whole range: no promotions or demotions
The limit tolerance, 3% over the last close, is a placeholder until Saransh sets the India Book's
The caps' room goes to the Sleeves in the order their strategies are named: the first named buys first, and a later one's buy is cut to what is left
A buy a rule cuts isn't bought later: its money waits in the cash fund until the strategy trades the stock again, the next weighting or, after the breakers, buys resume
Sectors are today's (the securities table's), as the strategies' own are

The cash fund earns one risk-free rate, 7.00% a year, throughout, and so does the cash waiting in the Sleeves, in fractions and without costs: years when bills paid less (2011–2016 and 2020–2021 in the US) earn more than they did
Each Sleeve buys what its strategy holds on the Book's first close at the next open, so it starts from the strategy's track rather than with its first rebalance
